items.text: Are all materials and plant in and around the site area required for the current work scope?
Are walkways and work areas clearly defined and barricaded?
Is the site and work area properly illuminated?
Are GCP best practices visible and in place?
Materials are stored in agreed laydown areas in line with expectations and with suitable access?
Are flammable or combustible materials stored in proper containers and locations?
Stacked materials are secure and in proper place?
Firefighting / first aid appliances are stored correctly?
Is housekeeping on the site and office areas in line with 5S policy of clean as you go?
Are welfare facilities in place and clean? Is vermin control in place and maintained?
Are GCP best practices visible and in place?
Is signage and barriers in place, sufficient, appropriate, clear and consistent?
Are there outstanding actions from the previous 5S audit?
